Description.description: State of the single rev_roundstatisticsresult row's most recent computation cycle: Pending from the moment the trustee portal writes rev_triggeredon on rev_roundstatisticsrequest until the Dataverse-triggered flow finishes, then Complete (rev_resultjson holds a fresh document) or Error (the flow could not compute it). FROM REVISION 5 (ADR-038) THE LIVE COLUMN THIS SET TYPES IS rev_roundstatisticsresult.rev_status: this set keeps its rev_roundstatisticsrequeststatus name while living on the result table, because renaming a global option set live is a metadata operation this project does not perform and the name is never rendered to a trustee (TAD section 3.9.2). It also still types the retained-but-unused rev_roundstatisticsrequest.rev_status, which is written by nothing. Options are never renumbered while a row references them.
